title: Farmer's Delights Tomato to Red Dye Recipe
description: Makes Farmer's Delights' tomatoes be able to be crafted into red dye
body:
**Made specifically and tested for Farmer's Delights Refabricated Fabric 1.21.11**

---
**This datapack might work for other versions too but I've haven't tried**

This datapack adds a crafting recipe for FDR, where you can turn a tomato into red dye by crafting a tomato with a water bucket/bottle
